data_fields.name: control_lease_expiry
data_fields.donor_constant: LoseControl set: EOT, EndOfCombat, Untap, LeavesPlay, LoseControl

best_idea: Store each spell as a data row that names one effect from a fixed registry plus its params, resolve it off a LIFO stack, and let a multi-target spell still hit its legal targets when only some are gone.
decision_why: Take the row-plus-registry shape and the partial-fizzle rule for spells as zone data; do not take the Java classes or the card-script grammar (GPL-3.0). Server resolves every hit inside src/fight.
acceptance: Server test: a 3-target X=10 spell gives each surviving target 3 (rounded down); a spell with one legal target left still hits that one; a spell with all targets gone fizzles; a GainControl lease with expiry endOfTurn returns the creature to its owner at turn end.
